automation_evidence.quote:
Paper reproduction: the agent reproduces the reported results of a recent forecasting
paper that has no official code

metric_evidence.quote:
TSFLab reproduces 73% of the 96 scheduled results
within 10% of the paper’s MSE, against 21–46% for the other settings.

evidence.quote:
Without the Experiment Workflower, agents write their own training and evaluation code; they
add the most code, and their errors move into evaluation, such as tuning on test scores and averaging batch
errors.

practical_problems.note: module ablation (with the guide ablation, whose rejected attempts used wrong ETTh1 split boundaries) shows that without shared splitting and execution agents tune on test scores; reported qualitatively as error types, not as a leakage-rate measurement

summary: Automates forecasting reproduction, benchmarking and method development for coding agents through a shared workbench with fixed chronological protocols; it raises task completion and reproduction fidelity and cuts tokens, and its module ablations qualitatively show protocol errors such as test-score tuning when the shared runner or guide is removed.
